desc: 亲子家庭装套图模版：白底挂拍、套装卖点、出行场景、包边细节与温馨收口
name: 温馨亲子家庭装套装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
一秒传达一家同款的家庭温馨感，建立核心卖点
代入家庭出行前的整理场景，营造温馨生活感
用包边与缝线微距证明做工细节
并列展示深浅两色家庭套装，让买家按家庭人数与颜色选择
粉色暖调收口促单，留空按钮位供后期合成促销信息

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for the main packshot, solid sakura pink #F2919E and soft blush pink #F7C5CC for benefit, variant and closing shots, warm cream #F5EDE3 for lifestyle
style.iconSystem: soft-edge pink badge and capsule label shapes only, no complex icons
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, rounded soft shadows, cozy warm mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm family-matching apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sakura pink #F2919E, soft blush pink #F7C5CC and charcoal text #3B3B3D; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, rounded gentle shadows and a cozy playful mood; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; simple soft-edge pink badge and capsule label shapes only, no complex icons; clean apparel photography with natural wooden hangers and soft fabric texture; stable garment scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable garment scale, garments hung or laid flat, centered placement, no human faces
style.surfaceSystem: natural wooden hangers and light wood rack, matte neutral board #EFE9E4 for detail work
